description: This file is a Java source code defining the class 'ConnectivityModelFactory', which serves as a factory for creating instances of various connectivity-related objects such as connections, metrics, sources, targets, payload mappings, and other related classes within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

classes.name: ConnectivityModelFactory
classes.description: A final class providing static factory methods to create and initialize various connectivity-related model objects within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

methods.name: newConnectionBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new ConnectionBuilder with specified id, type, status, and URI.

methods.name: connectionFromJson
methods.description: Constructs a Connection object from a JSON representation.

methods.name: newMeasurement
methods.description: Constructs a new Measurement with specified type, success flag, values, and last message timestamp.

methods.name: connectionMetricsFromJson
methods.description: Creates ConnectionMetrics from a JSON object.

methods.name: newConnectionMetrics
methods.description: Creates ConnectionMetrics with specified inbound and outbound AddressMetrics.

methods.name: emptyConnectionMetrics
methods.description: Returns an empty ConnectionMetrics instance.

methods.name: newSourceMetrics
methods.description: Creates SourceMetrics from address metrics map.

methods.name: emptySourceMetrics
methods.description: Returns an empty SourceMetrics instance.

methods.name: sourceMetricsFromJson
methods.description: Creates SourceMetrics from a JSON object.

methods.name: newTargetMetrics
methods.description: Creates TargetMetrics from address metrics map.

methods.name: emptyTargetMetrics
methods.description: Returns an empty TargetMetrics instance.

methods.name: targetMetricsFromJson
methods.description: Creates TargetMetrics from a JSON object.

methods.name: newClientStatus
methods.description: Creates a ResourceStatus for a client with specified ID, status, and optional details.

methods.name: newClientStatus (overload)
methods.description: Creates a ResourceStatus for a client with additional information about how long it has been in the current state.

methods.name: newSourceStatus
methods.description: Creates a ResourceStatus for a source with optional address and details.

methods.name: newTargetStatus
methods.description: Creates a ResourceStatus for a target with optional address and details.

methods.name: newStatusUpdate
methods.description: Creates a generic ResourceStatus update, can include 'inStatusSince' timestamp.

methods.name: resourceStatusFromJson
methods.description: Creates ResourceStatus from JSON.

methods.name: newAddressMetric
methods.description: Creates an AddressMetric from a set of measurements.

methods.name: newAddressMetric (merge)
methods.description: Merges an existing AddressMetric with additional measurements.

methods.name: emptyAddressMetric
methods.description: Returns an empty AddressMetric.

methods.name: addressMetricFromJson
methods.description: Creates AddressMetric from JSON.

methods.name: newMappingContextBuilder
methods.description: Creates a MappingContextBuilder with specified engine and options.

methods.name: newMappingContext
methods.description: Creates a MappingContext with specified engine and options or JSON.

methods.name: mappingsFromJson
methods.description: Creates a map of MappingContexts from JSON.

methods.name: emptyPayloadMappingDefinition
methods.description: Returns an empty PayloadMappingDefinition.

methods.name: newPayloadMappingDefinition (from map)
methods.description: Creates PayloadMappingDefinition from a map of definitions.

methods.name: newPayloadMappingDefinition (with id and context)
methods.description: Creates PayloadMappingDefinition with a specific id and mapping context.

methods.name: emptyPayloadMapping
methods.description: Returns an empty PayloadMapping.

methods.name: newPayloadMapping (from list)
methods.description: Creates PayloadMapping from a list.

methods.name: newPayloadMapping (from varargs)
methods.description: Creates PayloadMapping from variable arguments.

methods.name: newPayloadMapping (from JsonArray)
methods.description: Creates PayloadMapping from JSON array.

methods.name: newSourceBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new SourceBuilder.

methods.name: newSourceBuilder (from Source)
methods.description: Creates a SourceBuilder initialized with an existing Source.

methods.name: newSource
methods.description: Creates a new Source with given authorization context and address.

methods.name: newSource (with index)
methods.description: Creates a new Source with an index parameter.

methods.name: newTargetBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new TargetBuilder.

methods.name: newTargetBuilder (from Target)
methods.description: Creates a TargetBuilder initialized from an existing Target.

methods.name: newTarget
methods.description: Creates a new Target based on an existing target but with different address, qos, and acknowledgement label.

methods.name: newTarget (overloads)
methods.description: Various overloads to create Target with specific parameters, addresses, headers, topics, etc.

methods.name: sourceFromJson
methods.description: Creates Source object from JSON, considering connection type and index.

methods.name: targetFromJson
methods.description: Creates Target object from JSON.

methods.name: newFilteredTopic
methods.description: Creates FilteredTopic with optional filter string or namespaces.

methods.name: newFilteredTopicBuilder
methods.description: Creates a builder for FilteredTopic.

methods.name: newEnforcement
methods.description: Creates Enforcement object with input string and filters.

methods.name: newSourceAddressEnforcement
methods.description: Creates Enforcement for source address filtering with specific filters.

methods.name: newEnforcement (copy)
methods.description: Copies an existing Enforcement object.

methods.name: newHeaderMapping
methods.description: Creates HeaderMapping from a map.

methods.name: newHeaderMapping (from JSON)
methods.description: Creates HeaderMapping from JSON.

methods.name: logEntryFromJson
methods.description: Creates LogEntry from JSON.

methods.name: newLogEntryBuilder
methods.description: Creates a LogEntryBuilder with specified parameters (correlation ID, timestamp, category, type, level, message).
